name: X Posting Curator
tagline: One template that runs your whole X growth pipeline from sources to receipts
description: Replaces a four-bot X workflow with a single template that plays every role itself. It scouts real sources for material, drafts a few opening hooks that sound like you, and attaches fact-check notes before anything goes out. Reference material on the algorithm and direct-message handling round out the kit.
author: PixelRainbowNFT
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
